correctness.rationale: The stated Poisson clone family has mutant offspring mean 1, variance 1/r and finite higher moments. Doob size bias gives exact conditional mean -D(1+1/(rS))/2, conditional innovation variance S(1+3r)/(6r)+o_P(S), and O(n) second moments of both non-Perron contrasts. Uniformly finite-window conditional Lindeberg, exponentially decaying contrast memory, Gamma(2,1/(2r)) growth and continuous studentization reconstruct the claimed independent Gaussian AR(-1/2) limit. The packaged exact-rational verifier passes 129 identities, but the infinite-time limit rests on this analytic argument.
